## Summary

Describe the user-visible result.

## Motivation

Explain the problem or link an existing issue.

## Changes

List the relevant implementation decisions and any limitations.

## Testing

Record the exact commands, macOS/Xcode versions, and results. Separate unit tests from real desktop checks.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, include real before/after captures with personal information removed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing Swift/SwiftUI patterns.
- [ ] Relevant tests and the build pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Wallpaper preservation and restoration were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, generated wallpapers, or private screenshots are included.
